name: woocommerce/order-refunds-query
label: Query order refunds
description: List the refunds of an order, newest first. Use the woocommerce/order-refund-create ability to refund an order.

include.description: Limit the result to these refund IDs of the order.

reason.description: Reason for the refund. Omitted when none was given.

refunded_by.description: ID of the user who made the refund. Omitted when nobody was logged in.

refunded_payment.description: Whether WooCommerce recorded that the payment gateway refunded the payment. False for a manual refund, but also when the gateway or an extension refunded it and the refund was not marked as paid, so check with the gateway when a refund error asked you to.

date_created.description: Refund date in the store timezone.

line_items.description: Order lines that the refund covers. Empty for a refund of an amount only.

total.description: Amount refunded for the line, excluding tax. Negative for a discount or credit line.
